objective.question: Can the existing raw-observable Doppler WLS estimates seed the native Android IMU velocity and heading directly without running or handing off any GNSS-first optimizer state?

algorithm_contract.direct_source: Use FGOProblem::doppler_velocity_wls_estimates built from raw Doppler rows, broadcast satellite state, and raw SPP seeds.
algorithm_contract.coverage: Report direct-valid, propagated-valid, and rejected counts. Every problem epoch must have one valid finite estimate; otherwise fail closed before IMU initialization.
algorithm_contract.propagation: Only existing bounded linear interpolation or one-sided edge hold is permitted, with the existing maximum edge hold of 1.0 seconds. No alternate trajectory or coordinate propagation is permitted.
algorithm_contract.velocity_handoff: Hand off velocity-only ECEF estimates after conversion to ENU at the first original raw SPP seed. The same velocity sequence initializes IMU velocity states and the existing velocity-to-heading initializer.
algorithm_contract.position_clock_handoff: Never run or copy GNSS-first optimizer positions, velocities, or receiver clocks. Original raw SPP position and clock seeds remain in the IMU problem.
algorithm_contract.gnss_first: The GNSS-first optimizer is not attempted in this candidate; attempted=false is a mandatory summary gate.
algorithm_contract.failure_policy: Any rejected, non-finite, over-bound, missing, or incomplete estimate fails closed. No partial sequence, zero fallback, edge hold beyond 1.0 seconds, truth input, or precomputed coordinate is allowed.
algorithm_contract.physical_gates: Each direct or propagated estimate must be finite with velocity norm <=70 m/s and clock-rate magnitude <=2000 m/s; the native WLS residual, rank, condition, and normalized-RMS gates remain authoritative.
algorithm_contract.tdcp: Existing ordinary TDCP graph remains enabled by the base recipe and must build and insert a positive equal count.
algorithm_contract.raw_keys: Existing exact raw UTC-key alignment remains authoritative; no interpolated or edge-held output coordinate is accepted.

flag_off_identity_contract.scope: Run the frozen base recipe before and after candidate build on the Phase31 train3 and Phase37 safe2 raw routes.
flag_off_identity_contract.expected_baselines: The Phase39 freeze flag-off SHA-256 records remain authoritative; this candidate must not alter them.

execution_order: candidate source and focused tests commit and push
run MTV-h plus Phase31 train3 plus Phase37 safe2 twice each with candidate flag
run flag-off frozen baseline identity checks
publish truth-free structural result and manifest
seal only if every AND gate passes
forbidden_actions: use precomputed result/submission coordinates for inference
use an alternate trajectory or coordinate propagation
use edge hold beyond the existing 1.0 second bound
fit or apply a truth/common constant/body-frame correction
run the GNSS-first optimizer for the direct candidate
change production defaults or the Phase31 champion path
execute matrix before source and focused-test push
historical_binary_pin_policy: Any existing tests that pin a pre-Phase40 binary SHA remain historical records and are not rewritten. They are explained in the Phase40 result/manifest; new focused tests pin source/contract behavior and the candidate binary is rebuilt after the source push.
decision_rule: All gates are logically ANDed. Any missing input, invalid state, solver failure, coverage gap, TDCP mismatch, output contract violation, flag-off mutation, or nondeterminism is a fail-closed No-Go; no truth is opened in Phase40.
